question: What sacred object of the yoginī root knowledge is worshipped in this formula?
premises: The object is the auspicious pādukā of the yoginī root knowledge.
This is part of the recitation.
inference: The practitioner worships the auspicious pādukā of the yoginī root knowledge.
plain_english: And I worship the auspicious pādukā of the yoginī root knowledge.
